# Requirements Analysis Document — draft template

1. Project purpose: reusable engine plus separate demonstration game.
2. Target users and representative use cases.
3. Scope: required vs optional engine/game features.
4. Inputs, outputs, configuration and supported platforms.
5. Functional requirements: ID, behavior, owner, acceptance criteria, Jira link.
6. Nonfunctional requirements: measured performance/reliability/usability targets.
7. GUI sketches, navigation, gameplay parameters and agreed multiplayer rules.
8. Team responsibilities and dependencies.
9. Sprint plan, progress evidence, unresolved questions and risks.
10. Traceability: requirement → Jira → implementation → test.

Fill from reviewed team decisions; do not present starter placeholders as delivered requirements.
